title: Palindrome Check
description: Write a Zig program that checks if the word "racecar" is a palindrome (reads the same forward and backward).
hints: Compare characters from both ends moving inward
You only need to check half the string: `word.len / 2`
Use `break` to exit the loop early if a mismatch is found
